title: MI Query Agent — Stage 1 of the concept-proposal split: the completeness check
stage: 1 of 4 — completeness check, deterministic only. No model call anywhere in this stage.

what_was_built.production_behaviour_changed: NONE. Three new files; no existing file modified.

approach_decision.question: span coverage, or residue?
approach_decision.decided_on: measurement, not the docstring at question_interpretation/schema.py:273

span_coverage.verdict: REJECTED. Span availability is 33.9% on the questions that answered exactly and 34.5% on the questions that lost a concept, and median character coverage is HIGHER on the failures (98.6%) than on the successes (85.2%). No threshold separates the two populations: the best one available fires on 2 of 21 losses. An absent span is not evidence of a lost concept — it is evidence that the interpreter emitted a field key rather than the words, which it does two times in three.

residue.why: The failures are not uncovered TEXT, they are concepts an owner can resolve that never reach the contract. Asking each existing owner what it reads and comparing that against the estate's own record of what it executed separates the two populations; measuring how much of the sentence is covered does not.
residue.no_third_reader: Every reading is a call to an owner that already ships: requested_dimension_terms, categorical_spans.value_field, portfolio_lens, workspace.resolve_dataset, _detect_metric, _forecast_target_value (gated by answer_type.asked), detect_requested_facets. The module owns the COMPARISON and nothing else.

the_one_rule: A concept the sentence states is CARRIED only when the executed contract POSITIVELY RECORDS it. Silence is a finding, not a pass.

false_positives_by_name.cause: period_movement applied the Direct scope and published no record of it; its envelope matches Q19C's, where the same scope was dropped and the answer was wrong by £10.2m

false_positives_by_name.cause: evolution_pipeline_stage answered from the pipeline and published no population

false_negatives_by_name.question: Break Direct-book balance down by both broker channel and loan type.
false_negatives_by_name.cause: portfolio_lens does not read `Direct-book` outside a selector position; _detect_lost_narrowing sees the same words but only where a selector mark precedes them, which `For Direct-book` (Q05B) and `of Direct-book balance` (Q17B) have and `Break Direct-book balance` does not. No owner resolves the concept, so no deterministic check can see it lost.
false_negatives_by_name.consequence: The check's recall is the OWNERS' recall. That bound is the argument for a proposal step, not an argument against the check.

Q21B.why: the sentence names `balance` and the parser bound the measure to current_loan_to_value from the words `50% LTV`. The stated measure never reaches the contract, so a mis-binding shows here as a loss — correctly.

Q21C.why: `among` was bound as a categorical value. Every concept the sentence states IS in the contract; what is wrong is an extra binding the sentence never made. This check compares presence, not correctness, and adding a wrong-binding test would make it a second grader.

Q01B.why: both predicates were applied. Nothing was lost; the refusal is a guard reading one span twice. Silence here is the correct answer and is asserted by the calibration, not tolerated.

Q20B.why: product and movement were both captured and the movement route could not apply the predicate. Nothing was lost at interpretation.

the_finding_this_stage_produced.what: Five questions across the standing banks answer CORRECTLY and publish no record of having applied the scope or dataset they honoured: Q19B (period_movement), CFO69/CFO70/S32 (evolution), S29 (concentration_analysis).
the_finding_this_stage_produced.why_it_matters: Q19B's envelope and Q19C's are indistinguishable in every field the estate publishes — same declared scope `direct`, same absent population, same absent narrowing, same absent facet. Q19B answered £12.4m (the Direct truth). Q19C answered £22.6m (the whole book) and was wrong. No consumer of the receipt can tell them apart.
the_finding_this_stage_produced.where_the_fix_belongs: those routes' receipts, not this check. Suppressing the five would mean suppressing Q19C with them.

assurance.mi_regression: 278 modules, 85 failing names — IDENTICAL to the frozen baseline. Zero blast.
assurance.analytical_meaning_census: 0 in every category (measure, dataset, population, time, LEVEL/MOVEMENT, dimension, ranking, other)
mutation_controls: scope: accept a resolved scope as an applied one -> 2 tests fail
narrowing: count an applied grouping axis as narrowing -> 1 test fails
target: stop gating on answer_type.asked -> 1 test fails
dataset: trust the decision instead of the execution -> 1 test fails
scope mutation against the calibration -> CALIBRATION FAILED (type-(c) 20 -> 19, false-positive set and miss set both moved)
